dedupe_keys.name: cactus wind and water turbine simulator

description: CACTUS is Sandia National Laboratories' free-wake vortex code for axial- and cross-flow turbine simulation. It represents blade motion and wake development to estimate turbine loading and performance for wind or water rotor designs. Inputs are rotor geometry, airfoil characteristics, flow conditions and solver settings; outputs are aerodynamic or hydrodynamic performance and time histories for the configured machine. Spatial size and simulated duration follow the turbine case, not a fixed geographical region. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause, with CMake build instructions, a user manual, regression tests and example horizontal- and vertical-axis turbine inputs. A limitation is that a free-wake vortex approximation is not a full computational-fluid-dynamics solution for every complex flow or structure. Users need to check its validity for a particular design. It can support wind-farm and hydrokinetic generation simulations. The catalogue's model-openfoam is a broader fluid-dynamics package for comparison, not a CACTUS dependency. No test case was built or run.
inputs: Turbine blade geometry and airfoil data
Wind or water flow and solver settings
